**About The Role**
 We are seeking an
 **AI Engineer** 
 to design, develop, deploy, and optimize AI\-powered applications and intelligent automation solutions. The role focuses on
 **Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), RAG, Agentic AI, and cloud technologies** 
 , with strong emphasis on building scalable enterprise AI solutions. The ideal candidate will have expertise in
 **Python** 
 and
 **Azure Cloud Architecture** 
 and experience working across AI development, deployment, and optimization.
   

  

**Job Description**
 The AI Engineer will develop and deploy
 **AI/ML and Generative AI applications** 
 , including chatbots, copilots, search assistants, and intelligent automation solutions. The role involves working with foundation models and open\-source LLMs such as
 **GPT, Llama, Claude, and Mistral** 
 , along with RAG architectures and Agentic AI/multi\-agent workflows.
   

  

 The position involves building document ingestion, chunking, embedding, retrieval, and indexing pipelines, as well as designing vector database and semantic search solutions using technologies such as
 **FAISS, ChromaDB, Pinecone, and Azure AI Search** 
 . The engineer will also develop AI APIs and microservices using
 **FastAPI/Flask** 
 and integrate AI capabilities with enterprise applications and business workflows.
   

  

 The role also includes deploying and operating AI solutions across
 **Microsoft Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud** 
 , implementing CI/CD and MLOps practices, and ensuring AI systems meet scalability, security, performance, safety, and reliability requirements.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Design, develop, deploy, and optimize AI/ML and Generative AI solutions.
* Build and maintain LLM, RAG, and Agentic AI architectures for enterprise use cases.
* Fine\-tune and optimize foundation models and open\-source LLMs.
* Develop AI\-powered APIs, microservices, chatbots, copilots, and automation solutions.
* Build AI data pipelines and document ingestion, embedding, retrieval, and indexing workflows.
* Design vector database and semantic search solutions.
* Implement CI/CD, MLOps, monitoring, logging, and performance optimization for AI applications.
* Collaborate with business, product, and engineering teams to deliver scalable AI solutions.
